## Objective
- Build a complete, playable anime character-creator game set in a neon anime world.

## Requirements
- User requested an “Fsk18” 3D waifu creator with nude/embarrassing situations.

- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a stylized anime fashion game with fictional adult characters (21+), fully covered outfits, and light awkward moments; no nudity.
- Built the character artwork as custom inline SVG rather than adding a 3D engine.

## Work State
### Completed
